issues.description: Duplicate check uses case-sensitive comparison. "Buy milk" and "buy milk" are treated as distinct entries.
issues.suggestion: Normalize input with `.trim().toLowerCase()` before comparison: `tasks.some(t => t.title.trim().toLowerCase() === newTitle.trim().toLowerCase())`

issues.description: Task title is stored without sanitization; XSS possible if titles are rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML elsewhere.
issues.suggestion: Sanitize input with DOMPurify or a whitelist regex before storing: `title: DOMPurify.sanitize(rawTitle)`

issues.description: Store mutation logic directly modifies array indices (tasks[idx].completed = true) instead of using immutable updates.
issues.suggestion: Return a new array: `return tasks.map(t => t.id === id ? { ...t, completed: true } : t)`

codeQuality.summary: Critical bug in duplicate detection (case-insensitive mismatch) and a high-severity XSS risk from unsanitized input. Immediate fixes required.

untestedPaths.reasoning: The duplicate bug was introduced because this edge case had no test. Adding "Buy Milk" after "buy milk" should be rejected.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should reject case-insensitive duplicates", () => { addTask("buy milk"); expect(() => addTask("Buy Milk")).toThrow(/duplicate/i); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Whitespace-only titles can be added, creating invisible tasks.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should reject whitespace-only tasks", () => { expect(() => addTask("   ")).toThrow(/invalid/i); });

untestedPaths.location: toggleTask when id does not exist
untestedPaths.reasoning: Toggle on a non-existent ID silently fails, which can mask integration bugs.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should throw or return false for non-existent task id", () => { expect(() => toggleTask("non-existent-id")).toThrow(); });

testCoverage.summary: Store has some tests but critical edge cases are missing. The case-insensitive duplicate and whitespace-title cases are the highest priority additions.

suggestions.description: Adopt a reducer pattern (or use Zustand/Redux Toolkit) to make state transitions explicit and testable.
suggestions.benefits: Makes state transitions pure and predictable. Eliminates mutation bugs. Greatly improves testability.

suggestions.description: Extract the duplicate detection into a pure function `isExistingTask(tasks, title)` for reuse and unit testing.
suggestions.benefits: Pure function is trivially unit-tested and reusable across contexts (e.g. API validation layer).

refactorings.summary: The store would benefit significantly from adopting a reducer/immutable pattern and extracting the duplicate-detection logic into a pure, testable function.

recommendations.description: Duplicate check is case-sensitive — normalize titles to lowercase before comparison to fix the root bug this PR attempts to address.
Sanitize task titles with DOMPurify before storing to prevent potential XSS injection.
Add test for case-insensitive duplicate rejection and whitespace-only title validation.
Replace mutable array push/splice patterns with immutable reducer pattern to prevent future mutation bugs.
Extract `isExistingTask` as a standalone pure function for reuse and isolated testing.
